reforms.description: The government has initiated reforms to enhance the nation's innovative capacity by improving the flow of information and researchers among government research laboratories, universities, and businesses, while also raising the efficiency of public funding through competitive budgetary allocations and strict third-party evaluations of publicly funded projects.

reforms.description: The Japanese government has adopted measures to promote the establishment and growth of venture companies by improving the provision of private risk capital, including tax incentives and easing investment restrictions.

all_reforms_including_excluded.description: The government has introduced a law to promote technology transfer from universities to industry, enhancing collaboration and commercialization of research outcomes, while also revising patent-related laws to strengthen the protection of innovators' intellectual property rights, promoting greater use of dormant patents that could benefit middle-sized companies.
all_reforms_including_excluded.component_name: Technology Transfer Law and Patent Revisions
all_reforms_including_excluded.growth_orientation_rationale: Promoting technology transfer and strengthening IP protection are critical for enhancing innovation and commercialization of research.
all_reforms_including_excluded.status_evidence: The government has introduced a law to promote technology transfer from universities to industry.
all_reforms_including_excluded.importance_rationale: These reforms are significant but not major, focusing on improving technology transfer and IP frameworks.
all_reforms_including_excluded.source_quote: The patent-related laws have been revised to strengthen the protection of innovators’ intellectual property rights.
all_reforms_including_excluded.cross_verification_note: This reform promotes technology transfer from universities to industry and revises patent laws to protect intellectual property, directly supporting knowledge transfer.
